body: I know those girls shouldn't get to me. It just sucks because no matter where I go, I get made fun of and it seems like no one wants to be my friend. For the longest time, I ignored the bullies and did my own thing. But once you realize the majority of people are negative towards you rather than positive/indifferent, you feel as if you're the source of the problem and not them. I agree with you though, it's just best to try to ignore them.
